basic_info.description: Perched atop a boutique building, this stunning 3 bd/2 ba (+office) penthouse unit offers panoramic vistas of Twin Peaks and the Downtown skyline, framed by the clean lines of a recent modern remodel. The open-concept living, dining, and kitchen space is designed for both entertaining and everyday comfort, flowing seamlessly into a sunroom that captures morning light and houses in-unit laundry for added convenience. The lovely primary suite invites you to unwind with a luxurious bath and serene views, while the second full bath features a deep soaking tub  the perfect retreat after a long day. A flexible third bedroom is ideal as an office or small guest space and includes a generous closet. Rare for city living, the property boasts a sprawling 50-foot-wide level backyard a sunny, shared oasis ideal for outdoor gatherings, gardening, or simply relaxing. Additional amenities include bike parking and storage. Situated in hip East Mission, experience penthouse living where thoughtful design meets iconic San Francisco views!
